title: celld.json
description: Describes how tools/pack.ts packs a site for celld. Every field is optional; paths are relative to the site directory. Without a celld.json the SvelteKit adapter-cloudflare layout is assumed.

$schema.description: Editor hint: a path or URL of this schema.

worker.description: Server entry module with `export default { fetch }`. Omit it, or set null, for a static-only site.

assets.description: Directory of static files, served before the worker. A worker, assets, or both are required.

objects.description: Module exporting the site's Durable Object classes. Needs a worker.

exclude.description: Asset paths (relative to `assets`) never to serve, in addition to _worker.js, _routes.json, _headers, _redirects and .assetsignore.

immutable.description: Path prefixes of content-hashed files, served with a 1-year cache. Default: whichever of _app/immutable/ and _nuxt/ exist, plus assets/ if every file in it has a hash in its name.

mutable.description: Exact paths under the immutable prefixes that change between builds (never cached for long). _nuxt/builds/latest.json is always added.

auth.description: "required": visitors sign in first. "optional": everyone gets in and signed-in people are recognised. Unset: the site is public. Recorded per site on activation, not in the version.

check.description: Path a deploy requests on the new version before activating it, and probes on the live site after. false skips both.

notFound.description: "spa": a static-only site answers navigations to unknown paths with index.html (client-side routing).

minify.description: Minify the bundled server code, for big builds near the 16 MiB code limit.
